subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` as the canonical public SDK contract for provider-specific JSONL display events?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but public plugin SDK API shape and long-term compatibility are maintainer product decisions that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and leave the linked issue as the design venue until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the API direction.

options.title: Sponsor this contract
options.body: Keep the PR open for maintainer review and treat the hook/event union as the intended SDK direction before merge.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Ask for a smaller or differently shaped parser/display seam before accepting any public SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and leave the linked issue as the design venue until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the API direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history around the CLI parser, runner, and delivery-evidence boundary affected by this SDK decision.
